A black-and-white concept art sheet shows three new members of the same species with very different poses, heights, and body shapes. Each is drawn with detailed anatomical linework and tonal shading, emphasizing organic, sculptural forms while keeping the shared features — elongated limbs, smooth faces, and fluid anatomical surfaces. Each character is labeled with its name.

The Warden (left) – massive and broad, hunched forward as if carrying great weight. Thick layered plates cover the shoulders and arms like natural armor. Its hands drag the ground, fingers forming dripping claws. The head is low and recessed into the chest, with small sensory slits.

The Acolyte (center) – tall, slender, and asymmetrical, with arms around their chest. They wear long decorated robes. Long filaments hang from its wrists and spine, swaying like banners. Its head has a hollow crown-like basin.

The Harbinger (right) – mid-height, slightly twisted posture. The body shows partial freezing — fragments of ice forming along the ribs and forearms. It wears a thin harness of hardened resin and net hanging on the ground. Their cranial basin splits into two asymmetrical lobes.

The sheet includes small anatomical notes around the figures — hand sketches, material drips, and head details — reinforcing the study aspect. White paper background, inspired by @img1   without direct reproduction.

A black-and-white concept art sheet shows three members of the same species with very different poses, height and shape. Each figure highlights a distinct morphology and function, while preserving the core features. Each character is labeled with its name. 
The Wanderer left 
– lean and slightly hunched, wearing a tattered organic cloak fused to its back and a belt made of braided tendrils and a hood covering its enlarged head. 
The Arbiter center 
– extremely tall, muscular and heavy, with layered armor plates, faulds and a collar. Holds a staff, posture frontal and imposing. Small cranial basin. 
The Seer right 
– very small height, transparent cape. Wears thin cords, raising a hand. Oversized head basin. The layout includes small sketches of limbs and items. 
Draw inspiration from @img1 without reproducing exactly this character. White paper background
